dev._comment_passThroughEnv: SEV-12 dev-server fix: turbo 2.x defaults passThroughEnv=[] which strips all custom env vars (NODE_ENV, E2B_API_KEY, JWT_SECRET, REDIS_URL, etc.) before backend/web workers spawn — manifests as nodeEnv:'undefined' in VFS Startup Fingerprint and 'E2B_API_KEY not set' warnings even when keys are configured. Adding '*' forwards the orchestrator's env (populated by scripts/dev-runner.js from /opt/bing/.env) to all child processes so next dev + tsx-backed backend can read the keys.

build._comment_build_passThroughEnv: Builds use explicit allowlist (NOT '*') so production builds still gate on env presence — '*' is dev-only. Forwarded server secrets (DATABASE_URL / JWT_SECRET / ENCRYPTION_KEY / REDIS_URL) are needed because Next.js statically analyses process.env.* during `next build` and fails on missing-static-env even when the code path is server-only at runtime. Next.js's webpack DefinePlugin scopes inlining strictly to NEXT_PUBLIC_* so non-NEXT_PUBLIC vars are NOT baked into client bundles — passing them here only satisfies the build-time env presence check.
